title: Lighthouse serving roundtable prep (personal scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: quick, pragmatic sync to align serving runtime + infra + console for next sprint boundary. This is my personal prep sheet — keep it messy.

Meeting: Lighthouse Serving Roundtable (weekly)
When: Tue 10:00 — 30m (tentative)
Attendees (expected): runtime core, infra, console, sre rota, product PM (if time)
Goal: surface any high-risk regressions, unblock rollout plan for 0.9.2, confirm canary metrics + fallback policy changes.

Top-of-mind notes to self:
- Focus on two production regressions this week: HTTP/2 spike and KV cache invalidation after quantized warm-start. Do not let conversation drift.
- Bring concrete data: 99th pct latency delta from RED-2147, token-cost variance for small vs. medium batching.
- Ask infra to confirm node-count cushion for canary A (dedicated pool). If not, we need to delay rollout.

Draft agenda (30m)
1) Quick wins / wins since last sync (3m) — each team one sentence (keep short)
2) Production incidents / regressions (8m)
   - HTTP/2 spikes (RED-2147) — observed 99th from 420ms -> 1.1s on small seq workloads, need root cause hypothesis (Mikael).
   - KV cache invalidation after warm-starts (RED-2199) — noticing stalled throughput for 5–8 minutes on node restart (Priya).
3) Canary rollout status & decision point (8m)
   - Canary A (quantized v2) metrics: latency, mem, token cost, user-facing error rate. Need infra confirmation on reserve capacity. Decision: proceed to 25% or roll back.
   - Fallback policy changes (console route-level) — do we enable auto-fallback to float32 variant? Who owns failover test?
4) Console UX small ask (3m)
   - Add quick link to canary metrics in the route page. Quick ownership: Zara to propose UI copy and location.
5) Action items and owners (5m)

Prep checklist (for me before the meeting)
- [ ] Pull 7-day latency histograms and attach to meeting thread (done: graphs pinned to GH PR 482).
- [ ] Confirm infra cushion numbers (capacity cushion) — ping SRE channel.
- [ ] Draft fallback policy wording for console route settings (short copy).
- [ ] List of affected customers for outreach if we roll back.

Key data snippets to have on hand (short bullets to read aloud)
- RED-2147: Latency 99th increased +160% on 128-token median seq in region us-west-2 at 03/08 02:00 UTC.
- RED-2199: Warm-start invalidation observed on 5 restarts across canary nodes; throughput drop ~45% for 6±2 minutes.
- Canary quantized v2: avg token cost -18%, avg latency +12% (p50/p95 acceptable but p99 spike observed).

Open questions I want answered in the meeting
- Infra: Can we guarantee 20% spare capacity in dedicated pool for canary A next Tue? If not, what concrete step to provision?
- Runtime: Is there a reproducible sequence that triggers the HTTP/2 spike? If not, we need a short repro task assigned.
- Console: Is adding an auto-fallback toggle for route-level safe for GA? What telemetry do we need to expose first?

Proposed action items (capture during meeting; these are my starting proposals)
- Omar: produce one-pager with p50/p95/p99 graphs + cost delta for canary A by EOD Tue. (owner: Omar; due: 2026-03-10)
- Mikael: investigation ticket for HTTP/2 p99 spike with logs and perf traces; aim to produce root-cause hypothesis. (owner: Mikael Andersson; due: 2026-03-14)
- Priya: instrument KV cache invalidation metrics and add alert (RED-2199 follow-up). (owner: Priya Nair; due: 2026-03-13)
- Zara: design micro-proposal for route-level canary visibility in console + copy samples. (owner: Zara Thompson; due: 2026-03-12)
- SRE (ask: @sre-oncall): confirm capacity cushion and emergency scale playbook. (owner: SRE rota; due: 2026-03-11)

Notes on follow-ups (how I'll track)
- Create GH issue in serving-runtime for post-mortem if root cause found; link to RED tickets.
- Add tasks to the weekly board: label "lighthouse/canary" for easy filtering.
- Quick triage huddle if any new customer impact reported during rollout window.

Short scripts / one-liners I can read in the meeting (to keep tone tight)
- "We need two clear options at decision time: proceed to 25% canary with instrumentation checklist met, or hold and remediate. Which PR resolves the checklist?"
- "If infra cannot promise cushion, can we gate on scheduled scale event and set a rollback guard?"

Random scratch ideas (probably not in agenda but worth noting)
- Could we run a miniature synthetic workload that hits only long-tail paths to pre-stress p99 before rollout? (costy but cheap compared to customer regression)
- Temporary routing: send 5% traffic to float32 variant for last-mile verification of quality regressions.

Post-meeting capture template (what I'll paste into the meeting thread)
- Decision: (proceed/hold)
- Action items: one-line owner + due date + link to issue
- Follow-up: who will do customer comms and when

Personal reminder: keep agenda tight, no deep debugging in this slot. If we need a dedicated deep-dive, schedule 60m next week with traces preloaded.

—— end scratchpad ———

History/versions for my notes (short):
- 2026-03-10 initial outline
- 2026-03-11 added data snippets and proposed actions
- 2026-03-12 updated deadlines and added Zara as console owner

Slack locs I might reference in meeting
- #serving-runtime-incidents thread: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/CRX12345
- #infra-provisioning: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/CINFRA99

Quick brain dump of possible risks to escalate to PM/CS if rollout goes wrong
- Customer-facing latency regressions in query-heavy tenants (top customers: ACME, NovaTech) — pre-alert CS if canary shows p99 > target
- Billing/cost anomalies if quantized path increases token count or causes retries

End.
